categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in aerospace and communication technology, focusing on four main segments: aerospace products, satellite communication and measurement & control testing equipment, aviation products, and aerospace process equipment. These segments serve research institutes and main contractors in the aerospace field, providing technical solutions and manufacturing support.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 17 core technologies including complex microwave feed component design and manufacturing, starborne waveguide slot array antenna manufacturing and welding, large thin-wall polyimide injection molding, aerospace composite material tooling design, aerospace tooling manufacturing, satellite communication and measurement & control feed system design, lightweight foldable reflector design, high-precision servo tracking control, aerospace composite parts design and manufacturing, and high-precision composite parts molding. Production methods emphasize precision CNC machining, composite material processing, automated production lines, and advanced welding and heat treatment techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major state-owned aerospace and aviation enterprises and research institutes such as China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, China Electronics Technology Group Corporation, China Aviation Industry Corporation, China Commercial Aircraft Corporation, and their subsidiaries. The company serves national major aerospace projects including manned spaceflight, lunar exploration, Mars exploration, Beidou navigation, and large aircraft manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily domestic within China, covering regions including North China, East China, Central China, Northwest China, and Southwest China. It has subsidiaries located in Chengdu, Changsha, and Zigong, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, assembly, and testing of aerospace components, satellite communication equipment, and aerospace tooling. It acts as a key supplier to large aerospace system integrators and research institutes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding product applications and strategic layout in aerospace and satellite communication, enhancing production and quality management, accelerating aerospace industrial park construction, and advancing automation, intelligence, and informatization. R&D focuses on core aerospace technologies, composite materials, satellite communication feed systems, and aerospace tooling, with significant investment in new product development and technology breakthroughs to support national aerospace projects and commercial aerospace markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized aerospace products and technical services to government-affiliated research institutes and aerospace system integrators. The company follows a make-to-order production model with pricing based on technical complexity, material consumption, and competitive factors, finalized through negotiation or public bidding.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier in specialized aerospace components and satellite communication equipment, competing with other state-owned and private aerospace manufacturers. It holds a strong market position in niche segments such as satellite communication feed systems and aerospace composite tooling, supported by proprietary technologies and long-term contracts with major aerospace groups.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 508 million, an 11.36% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 101.57 million, a 24.42% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 2.44 billion, growing 4.61%, and net assets were RMB 1.63 billion. R&D investment accounted for 11.9% of revenue, reflecting a growth in innovation spending. The company has shown steady revenue growth with some profit margin pressure due to product mix changes.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive technical capabilities across design, simulation, precision manufacturing, assembly, and testing, enabling delivery of high-reliability, high-precision aerospace components and systems. Its proprietary core technologies in microwave feed components, composite materials, and satellite communication feed systems provide competitive advantages. The company also highlights its integrated industrial chain, strong customer relationships with major aerospace groups, and ability to rapidly respond to customized orders with high-quality products.
